<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex036012026-04-1301-16-04" status="reviewed">sgyur lugs ni 
            <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie"><note type="gloss">rgya</note> a rgya</foreign> zhes pa na 'phags pa'o || 
            <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">mu la</foreign> na gzhi' 'o ||
            sa r+ba na thaMd do || 
            <lb edRef="inst:7313" n="5a6"/> <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">a ti</foreign><note type="gloss">For the Sanskrit asti</note> na yod par ro || 
            <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">bad</foreign><note type="gloss">For the Sanskrit vāda (in the title: vādi)</note> na smra ba'o || 
            <note type="gloss">rgya</note> <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">sh+ra ma ne ra</foreign> na dge' tshul lo || 
            <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">ka ri ka</foreign> na tshig le 'ur byas pa'o || 
            <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">'bri ti</foreign> na 'grel pa'o || 
            <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">pra ba ba ti</foreign> na 'od ldan no ||</seg></TEI>
source: 2_036_01 sBal ti jo sras_grel pa od ldan gyi tshig don gsal byed.xml
